blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On Friday, Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano criticized netizens and television news anchors over their comments on his proposal for voluntary contributions of ₱170,000 to help pay the country’s national debt, saying they had misunderstood his suggestion. Cayetano took issue with social media users and news anchors who questioned what ordinary Filipinos could buy with P170,000, pointing out that his proposal was not intended for those struggling to make ends meet.
